prompt: GNU diff expand-tabs encoding error column width treatment
answer:
GNU `diff` does not reliably calculate display columns for encoding errors. Its documented/assumed treatment is that each encoding-error byte occupies one column, but this assumption can be incorrect; multibyte and non-ASCII characters can also make column calculations wrong, particularly with `--side-by-side`. Consequently, tab expansion and alignment may be inaccurate for such input.

Sources: [diffutils-devel discussion](https://lists.libreplanet.org/archive/html/diffutils-devel/2023-07/msg00031.html), [GNU diff documentation excerpt](https://www.linuxtopia.org/online_books/linux_tool_guides/comparing_and_merging_linux_files/diff_101.html).
